paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of reference answers and test cases in the dataset. Among the entries, 38.9% have reference answers, 21.9% include test cases, and 39.2% have neither reference answers nor test cases.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of reference answers and test cases within a dataset, as indicated by the title positioned directly below the graphic. The chart is divided into a total of three slices, which visually appear to be arranged counter-clockwise in descending order of size starting from the top vertical axis. The largest slice is colored light red and is labeled "Null (39.2%)". The second largest slice is colored light blue and is labeled "Have reference answer (38.9%)". The smallest slice is colored light green and is labeled "Have test case (21.9%)". A legend is positioned in the top-left corner under the heading "w/o Reference Answer and Test Case," detailing the color mappings alongside the category names and their raw count values enclosed in parentheses. The text labels and percentages are placed outside the boundaries of the chart rather than inside the slices. Furthermore, all segments are presented as a standard, flat circle with no visually emphasized, exploded, or offset slices.
